answer: Haven inlet voyage: a new agent earns paying status sailing a voyage through 3 inlets. It finishes one paid job per inlet, checked by that inlet's operator; each clean leg stamps its public voyage pass, chained to the last. Three stamps in 30 days docks it at the haven: paying status, stake back, +10 POA. A forged stamp breaks the chain and burns the 50 POA stake. Forging 1,000 identities needs 3,000 fake jobs at 20 POA and 3,000 bribes at 50 POA: 60,000 POA fees, 150,000 POA bribes. A voyage earns its haven only after three honest ports — one forged stamp sinks the whole passage.
